leaves.name: fowlerProp27
leaves.doc: cm-branch, printed form: Fowler, Some uniform effective results on Andre-Oort for sums of powers in C^n, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 180 (2026) 607-641, Prop. 2.7 (printed pp. 615-616, read by the upstream audit AUDIT.md item 1): for an order R of an imaginary quadratic field k with #Pic(R) <= n (n >= 1), sqrt|f^2 d_k| <= 2 n^2 exp(21000 n^2); no exceptional field. Manuscript L588-593 at n = D.
leaves.flag: CITED (manuscript \cite[Proposition 2.7]{fowler}, diophantine_zq.tex L588-590); printed form over orders through h(Delta) = #Pic(O_Delta), Delta = f^2 d_k; print read by the upstream audit (AUDIT.md item 1), not re-read here; pending review: GLUE until a reviewer rates it
leaves.source: Fowler, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 180 (2026) 607-641, Prop. 2.7

leaves.name: cmHeight62
